description: Read the saved Autopilot account configuration (schedule, limits, approval choices) and its expectedUpdatedAt revision (null when nothing is saved). Free; changes nothing and starts no work. Needs read:accounts. Preserve expectedUpdatedAt for any later change. The app table keeps no request-ID ledger, so this read alone is not proof of a specific earlier request.
name: soclo_autopilot_read
title: Read your saved Autopilot settings
